title: Shortest distance to a horizontal line
statement:
Give the squared distance from $(3,2+[$a])$ to its closest point on the line $y=2$.

[__________]{a}
hints: The variable square is minimized at zero.
solution: $(x-3)^2+[$a]^2$ is minimized at $x=3$, so squared distance is $[$a]^2$.

feedback.message: The variable square is minimized at zero.
